data.body: Triage (orphan sweep): RESOLVED. The batch-commit write primitive exists on main @9bdb22f5887: batch_stage_and_commit(tracker, items) at src/rebar/_store/event_append.py:479 — one lock acquire, M event files each retaining its own UUID-named path, one 'git add' + one commit, all-or-nothing rollback. The importer routes through it in 256-event chunks at src/rebar/_io/import_ndjson.py:190-196, and the single-event path is untouched (only the importer sets the _seam.batch_sink contextvar — src/rebar/_commands/_seam.py:35-51). Tests: tests/unit/test_store_batch_write.py (6 passed), tests/interfaces/io/test_import_batching.py, tests/interfaces/io/test_import_batch_resume.py. Note: the broader op-batching-for-all-mutations work tracked by e3d0-16d9-61ca-4862 is NOT covered by this and remains open.
